snippet.title: Dead Take Teaser - Surgent Studios (Pocketpair Publishing)
snippet.description:
Dead Take

Developed by Surgent Studios
Published by Pocketpair Publishing

Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.
Coming soon.
